issue.title: AWS saml2aws expiration information is not obtained when using source_profile

repository.name: starship
repository.description: ☄🌌️  The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell!

issue.body:
#### Current Behavior
In AWS saml2aws expiration information is not obtained when using `source_profile=saml` in `~/.aws/config` as the `~/.aws/credentials` files will contain only `source_profile` credentials  and not the actual profile credentials.

#### Expected Behavior
When using [saml2aws](https://github.com/Versent/saml2aws) the expiration information should be obtained from `~/.aws/credentials`  falls back to the `x_security_token_expires` key of the `source_profile` section i.e. `[saml]`.

#### Additional context/Screenshots
- `~/.aws/config` Sample
   ```ini
   [profile RO_User]
   source_profile=myaws
   refion = eu-west2
   output = json
   role_arn=arn:aws:iam::1234567890123:role/ReadOnlyRole
   role_session_name=RO_User

   [profile Admin_User]
   source_profile=myaws
   refion = eu-west2
   output = json
   role_arn=arn:aws:iam::1234567890123:role/AdministratorRole
   role_session_name=Admin_User
   ```
- `~/.aws/credentials` Sample
   ```ini
   [saml]
   aws_access_key_id        = MyAWSAccessKeyId
   aws_secret_access_key    = MyAwsSecretAccessKey
   ...
   x_security_token_expires = TimeDateOfTokenExpiry
   ```

#### Possible Solution
<!--- Only if you have suggestions on a fix for the bug -->

#### Environment
- Starship version: 1.13.1
- zsh version: zsh 5.8.1 (x86_64-apple-darwin22.0)
- Operating system: Mac OS 13.2.1
- Terminal emulator: iTerm.app 3.4.15

```

```
